host.title: Listen Address
host.tooltip: Leave EMPTY to bind to all interfaces

useIPv6.title: Use IPv6
useIPv6.tooltip: Controls whether IPv6 addresses are included when binding to all interfaces.

hostPortRangeStart.title: Port Range Start
hostPortRangeStart.tooltip:
The first available port within the configured range is selected to host a multiplayer game. Keep this value equal to 'Port Range End' to always host on a specific port only.
Valid values are 1024-65535

hostPortRangeEnd.title: Port Range End
hostPortRangeEnd.tooltip:
The first available port within the configured range is selected to host a multiplayer game. Keep this value equal to 'Port Range Start' to always host on a specific port only.
Valid values are 1024-65535

port.title: Port
port.tooltip: Port used for peer-to-peer connections. Leave at 0 to automatically select the first available port

regroupDistantPlayersOnCombatStart.title: Regroup distant players when combat starts
regroupDistantPlayersOnCombatStart.tooltip: When enabled, the host teleports player-controlled characters more than 30 metres away close to the party member who engaged the enemy. The host-authoritative combat initialization then synchronizes their positions for every player.

hideServerAddress.title: Hide Server Address
hideServerAddress.tooltip: Toggles whether the server IP address is shown in the UI. When enabled, the IP address is hidden to protect privacy

trackConnectionHistory.title: Track Connection History
trackConnectionHistory.tooltip: Successfully joined games will be available for a quick join

maxConnectionHistoryRecords.title: Maximum number of stored connection history records

ping.title: Ping
ping.tooltip: Use it to quickly highlight a specific world position, unit, map object, or other target. Your ping will be visible to other players, helping you communicate important locations or points of interest

showLobby.title: Show Lobby (Host)
showLobby.tooltip: Opens the host lobby window, which can also be accessed through the Esc menu

forceUnpause.title: Force Unpause (Host)
forceUnpause.tooltip: Completely removes local pause. Host-only recovery tool for bugs with synchronized pause

forceCombatEnd.title: Force Combat End (Host)
forceCombatEnd.tooltip: Immediately and forcefully exits the current combat state. Host-only recovery tool for stuck, desynchronized, or incorrectly ending combat

dangerZone.title: Danger zone (make sure you know what you are doing)

defaultForcedPauseTimeout.title: Default 'Forced pause' timeout
defaultForcedPauseTimeout.tooltip:
Default delay to lift forced pause once specific criteria is met.
Basic format is 00:00:00 (but not limited to) which means Hours:Minutes:Seconds

restEncounterForcedPauseTimeout.title: Rest encounter 'Forced pause' timeout
restEncounterForcedPauseTimeout.tooltip:
Delay to lift forced pause once random rest encounter is synchronized for everyone.
Basic format is 00:00:00 (but not limited to) which means Hours:Minutes:Seconds

restEncounterSyncTimeout.title: Rest Encounter synchronization timeout
restEncounterSyncTimeout.tooltip:
Client must wait for host to generate random rest encounter data (if any).
Banter skips are synchronized for everyone, so this (generation on host, retrieval on client) should happen around the same time

networkAwaiterTimeout.title: Network Awaiter timeout
networkAwaiterTimeout.tooltip: Sometimes we need to make requests rather than passively listen for incoming messages. This is a generic timeout for such cases where those requests are considered failed

enforcedCombatStartDelay.title: Enforced combat start delay
enforcedCombatStartDelay.tooltip: Combat will be started automatically after a specified delay (in seconds) if it's already started for someone else

combatTurnDelayForAI.title: AI Turn delay
combatTurnDelayForAI.tooltip:
AI turn for clients starts a bit later so AI actions can be synced/overridden from host if needed.
Keep this value slightly higher than your network ping, but increase it further depending on how much the game starts to stutter for the host during longer play sessions

playerTurnEndDelay.title: Remote Player Turn-End delay
playerTurnEndDelay.tooltip:
How long to wait after a remote player ends their turn before advancing the game.
Some spell animations are not handled correctly by the game (e.g., Kineticist Fire Blast), so the game thinks the acting character is not 'busy' and ends the turn before character actually finishes casting. This flat delay exists to mitigate such issues.

combatPauseCooldown.title: Combat Pause Cooldown
combatPauseCooldown.tooltip: Pausing is unavailable for the specified duration once combat begins for one or more players. Set to 00:00:00 to disable

saveGameChunkSize.title: Save Game chunk size
saveGameChunkSize.tooltip:
Controls chunk size (bytes) when transferring save game over the network. Smaller chunks can improve stability on slower or unstable connections, while larger chunks may increase transfer speed on fast networks.
Changing this value can affect connection reliability and compatibility. Only modify it if you understand how networking and data transfer work. Incorrect values may cause slow transfers, connection issues, or failed uploads/downloads.

localUnitDeathNotificationDelay.title: Unit Death notification delay
localUnitDeathNotificationDelay.tooltip: Adds a delay before sending a unit death notification to other players. This helps ensure the same action has already occurred for them. Set to 00:00:00 to disable

remoteUnitDeathProcessingDelay.title: Unit Death processing delay
remoteUnitDeathProcessingDelay.tooltip: Adds a delay before processing a unit death notification received from other players. This helps ensure the same action has already occurred locally. Set to 00:00:00 to disable
